Flight of the Fjord  One of the most beautiful landscapes I have ever seen with my own eyes. Just stunning! This flight was above the world famous Geirangerfjord, part of the West Norwegian Fjords UNESCO World Heritage site and the only natural UNESCO site in all of Norway. Conditions were relatively good with a slight tailwind up top, which meant we had to be careful on the exit. The flight itself was incredible. I'll be dreaming about that flatter rocky terrain for years to come, then punching through the small cloud before landing in a beautiful grassy field. This jump really had it all!

“I think my dad is Spiderman” 🥹❤️ (Crowdfund L1NK 1N B10) #spiderman #homeless #kindness #father #family  Internet meet David. David is a 35 year old single dad, currently living in the shelter with his three beautiful children. David’s dream is to have a job and safe home, to provide a better life than he had for his kids. After talking with David, I learnt that his partner has battled with mental health and other serious issues, and unfortunately is not playing a significant role in the life of their children, so David has full custody of them. David is doing his best he can but struggling to get out of the hole he currently is in. Furthermore, when I asked David what he wanted to do for work, he told me, “I am willing to do anything for my babies.” If you are willing to hire David and/or know someone who would in the NYC area, please email our team at zachery@onefluent.com with the E-Mail Title “Job For David” and we will get back to you as soon as possible. Let's all come together and show David the power of the internet and bless him and his babies. 100% of the net funds raised will go to covering David’s living expenses and finding this family a home. Be kind and love always ❤️

#ad For me, this one is personal. Breast cancer has touched my family more than once. Two of my aunts and a cousin have faced it, and so has one of my friends. Like so many Canadians, it's a reminder of just how many lives are impacted. That's why I'm taking part in the Canadian Cancer Society CIBC Run for the Cure. For one powerful day, people across Canada come together to run, walk, fundraise and honour the important people in our lives affected by breast cancer. But the impact lasts far beyond that one day. One Day. Endless Impact. Every step taken and every dollar raised helps power life-saving breast cancer research, compassionate support programs and future breakthroughs—giving hope to people affected by breast cancer today and for generations to come. The end of the Run is just the beginning. Your participation today helps fuel tomorrow's breakthroughs. Whether you run, walk or simply want to support the cause, I'd love for you to join me. Sign up for the Canadian Cancer Society CIBC Run for the Cure on October 4 using the link in my bio. #sponsored #CIBCRunForTheCure @CIBC @cancersociety
